description.value: Urban Fare is a supermarket in Vancouver's Yaletown neighborhood on Davie Street. It serves as a grocery resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the area.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (7 spaces) at 45m; stands (10 spaces) at 66m; stands (7 spaces) at 98m. Total: 24 spaces.
